test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All teachers are doctors.

2. All doctors are students.

**Conclusions:**

I. All teachers are students.

2. All students are doctors.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2eea99c37cb479434147a04047e4cb67a6772ab7c3ae7250d57fac6bc957ca52.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All teachers are students → Follow (As all teachers are doctors and all doctors are students. As whole teachers comes in doctors which whole comes in students, therefore it is true.)

II. All students are doctors → Does not follow (As all doctors are students. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
